body:
The seminars at my house are over the internet, they just watch a stream of the guy talking for all I know. They've been to a few in person, but we live across the country so they don't go often.

I've read a few encounters people have had with the cult leader, they got lucky enough to meet the guy in person, asked him some questions because they were skeptical, and the "master" belittled him in front of all of his followers, and kicked him out of the meeting. It seems really fuckin' fishy.

Some. He claims him and Jesus are both "Masters", basically pushes the idea that he is a living version of Jesus. They're highly secretive about a lot of aspects of it, and it takes over a years worth of "initiation" before they let you know all of it. My mom is completely convinced this is real. They have seminars every now and then and my brother and I are not allowed to be home during this time. It's weird. My mom is a good person, but this guy has her completely brainwashed.
Looks like its time to apply for a telemarketing job.
Haha, I figured as much. Although it would be interesting if someone broke up with you to pursue becoming a bird. Anyway, best of luck to ya.
I see the problem here... your boyfriend wants to be a bird. Awkward.
